sections.label: Book 37
sections.name: The Pravargya rite: the three caldrons

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे नारिरसि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade nārirasi
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, etc. Spa-le art thou. Woman art thou, etc., as in XI.

verses.sa: युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः। वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ svāhā
verses.en: The priests of him the lofty Priest, etc., as in V.

verses.sa: देवी द्यावापृथिवी मखस्य वामद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: devī dyāvāpṛthivī makhasya vāmadya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: O Heaven and Earth divine, may I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sa: देव्यो वम्र्यो भूतस्य प्रथमजा मखस्य वोऽद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: devyo vamryo bhūtasya prathamajā makhasya vo'dya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: Ye who were born the earliest of creation, Ants divine, may I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sa: इयत्यग्र आसीन्मखस्य तेऽद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: iyatyagra āsīnmakhasya te'dya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: Only so large was it at first. Duly may I prepare for you this day the head of Makha on earth's place where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! I

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्यौज स्थ मखस्य वोऽद्य शिरो राध्यासं देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: indrasyauja stha makhasya vo'dya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: Indra's effective might are ye. Duly may I prepare for you this day the head of Makha on earth's place where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sa: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता। अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, etc., as in XXXIII. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in verse

verses.sa: मखस्य शिरोऽसि। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखस्य शिरोऽसि। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखस्य शिरोऽसि। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: makhasya śiro'si makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhasya śiro'si makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhasya śiro'si makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head! Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head! Thou art the head of Makha, thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head! I For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in. verse

verses.sa: अश्वस्य त्वा वृष्णः शक्ना धूपयामि देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। अश्वस्य त्वा वृष्णः शक्ना धूपयामि देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। अश्वस्य त्वा वृष्णः शक्ना धूपयामि देवयजने पृथिव्याः। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: aśvasya tvā vṛṣṇaḥ śaknā dhūpayāmi devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe aśvasya tvā vṛṣṇaḥ śaknā dhūpayāmi devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe aśvasya tvā vṛṣṇaḥ śaknā dhūpayāmi devayajane pṛthivyāḥ makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: Thee on Gods sacrificial ground with stallion's dung I fumigate. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! I For Mahi thee, thee for the head c! of Makha! I For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sa: ऋजवे त्वा साधवे त्वा सुक्षित्यै त्वा। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे। मखाय त्वा मखस्य त्वा शीर्ष्णे॥
verses.tr: ṛjave tvā sādhave tvā sukṣityai tvā makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe
verses.en: Thee for the True. Thee for the Good. Thee for the place of happy rest. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! I For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! I

verses.sa: यमाय त्वा मखाय त्वा सूर्यस्य त्वा तपसे। देवस्त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु पृथिव्याः संस्पृशस्पाहि। अर्चिरसि शोचिरसि तपोऽसि॥
verses.tr: yamāya tvā makhāya tvā sūryasya tvā tapase devastvā savitā madhvānaktu pṛthivyāḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi arcirasi śocirasi tapo'si
verses.en: For Yama thee. For Makha thee. For Sdrya's fervent ardour thee. May Savitar the God with balm anoint thee. Guard thou.Flame art thou; thou art radiance; thou art heat.

verses.sa: अनाधृष्टा पुरस्तादग्नेराधिपत्य आयुर्मे दाः पुत्रवती दक्षिणत इन्द्रस्याधिपत्ये प्रजां मे दाः। सुषदा पश्चाद्देवस्य सवितुराधिपत्ये चक्षुर्मे दा आस्रुतिरुत्तरतो धातुराधिपत्ये रायस्पोषं मे दाः। विधृतिरुपरिष्टाद्बृहस्पतेराधिपत्ये ओजो मे दा विश्वाभ्यो मा नाष्ट्राभ्यस्पाहि मनोरश्वासि॥
verses.tr: anādhṛṣṭā purastādagnerādhipatya āyurme dāḥ putravatī dakṣiṇata indrasyādhipatye prajāṃ me dāḥ suṣadā paścāddevasya saviturādhipatye cakṣurme dā āsrutiruttarato dhāturādhipatye rāyaspoṣaṃ me dāḥ vidhṛtirupariṣṭādbṛhaspaterādhipatye ojo me dā viśvābhyo mā nāṣṭrābhyaspāhi manoraśvāsi
verses.en: Unconquerable, eastward, in Agni's overlordship, give me life. Rich in sons, southward, in Indra's overlordship give me offspring. Fair-seated, westward, in God Savitar's overlordship, give me sight. Range of hearing, northward, in Dhitar's overlordship, give me increase of wealth. Arrangement, upward, in Brihaspati's overlordship, give me energy. From all destructive spirits guard us. Thou art Manu's mare.

verses.sa: स्वाहा मरुद्भिः परि श्रीयस्व दिवः संस्पृशस्पाहि। मधु मधु मधु॥
verses.tr: svāhā marudbhiḥ pari śrīyasva divaḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi madhu madhu madhu
verses.en: All-hail! By Maruts be thou compassed round. Guard the sky's touches. Mead, mead, mead.

verses.sa: गर्भो देवानां पिता मतीनां पतिः प्रजानाम्। सं देवो देवेन सवित्रा गत संसूर्येण रोचते॥
verses.tr: garbho devānāṃ pitā matīnāṃ patiḥ prajānām saṃ devo devena savitrā gata saṃsūryeṇa rocate
verses.en: Germ of the Gods, Father of hymns, all living creatures' guardian Lord, Radiant, with radiant Savitar united, with the Sun he shines.

verses.sa: समग्निरग्निना गत सं दैवेन सवित्रा सं सूर्येणारोचिष्ट। स्वाहा समग्निस्तपसा गत सं दैव्येन सवित्रा संसूर्येणारूरुचत॥
verses.tr: samagniragninā gata saṃ daivena savitrā saṃ sūryeṇārociṣṭa svāhā samagnistapasā gata saṃ daivyena savitrā saṃsūryeṇārūrucata
verses.en: Agni combined with flaming Are, combined with Savitar divine, hath shone together with the Sun.

verses.sa: धर्ता दिवो वि भाति तपसस्पृथिव्यां धर्ता देवो देवानाममर्त्यस्तपोजाः। वाचमस्मे नि यच्छ देवायुवम्॥
verses.tr: dhartā divo vi bhāti tapasaspṛthivyāṃ dhartā devo devānāmamartyastapojāḥ vācamasme ni yaccha devāyuvam
verses.en: He shines on earth upholder of the sky and heat, the God' upholder, God, immortal, born of heat.

verses.sa: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम्। स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्त्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvartti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ
verses.en: I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching by his pathways and departing. He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sa: विश्वासां भुवां पते विश्वस्य मनसस्पते विश्वस्य वचसस्पते सर्वस्य वचसस्पते। देवश्रुत्त्वं देव घर्म देवो देवान् पाह्यत्र प्रावीरनु वां देववीतये। मधु माध्वीभ्यां मधु माधूचीभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: viśvāsāṃ bhuvāṃ pate viśvasya manasaspate viśvasya vacasaspate sarvasya vacasaspate devaśruttvaṃ deva gharma devo devān pāhyatra prāvīranu vāṃ devavītaye madhu mādhvībhyāṃ madhu mādhūcībhyām
verses.en: Lord of all earths, Lord of all mind, Lord of all speech, thon Lord of speech entire. Heard by the Gods, Caldron divine, do thou, a God, protect the Gods. Here, after, let it speed you twain on to the banquet of the Gods. Sweetness for both the sweetness-lovers! Sweetness for those the twain who take delight in sweetness!

verses.sa: हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा दिवे त्वा सूर्याय त्वा। ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरं दिवि देवेषु धेहि॥
verses.tr: hṛde tvā manase tvā dive tvā sūryāya tvā ūrdhvo adhvaraṃ divi deveṣu dhehi
verses.en: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the sky, for Surya thee. Standing erect lay thou the sacrifice in heaven among the Gods.

verses.sa: पिता नोऽसि पिता नो बोधि नमस्ते अतु मा मा हिंसीः। त्वष्टृमन्तस्त्वा सपेम पुत्रान्पशून्मयि धेहि प्रजामस्मासु धेह्यरिष्टाऽहं सह पत्या भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: pitā no'si pitā no bodhi namaste atu mā mā hiṃsīḥ tvaṣṭṛmantastvā sapema putrānpaśūnmayi dhehi prajāmasmāsu dhehyariṣṭā'haṃ saha patyā bhūyāsam
verses.en: Thou art our Father, father-like regard us. Obeisance be, 'to, thee. Do not thou harm us. May we, Accompanied by Tvashtar, win thee. Vouchsafe me sons and cattle. Grant us offspring. Safe may I be together with my husband.

verses.sa: अहः केतुना जुषतां सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा। रात्रिः केतुना जुषतां सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ahaḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā rātriḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā
verses.en: May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All hail! … u May M ly Night together with her sheen, fair lighted with her light, accept. All-hail!
